our_interpretation: Some actions includes particular requested tasks, rather than requiring an entire task family to score zero.
The zero must belong to PaLM-SayCan itself, including its reported additional capabilities, rather than a baseline without the language model.
The household remark expresses the practical significance of a failed chore; it supplies no separate numerical reliability standard.
The target is the evaluation released in August 2022.
criteria.support_condition: The original report identifies at least one PaLM-SayCan task with an observed execution success rate of zero.
criteria.contradiction_condition: All reported PaLM-SayCan tasks have positive execution success, and any zero results belong only to other systems or different metrics.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Readable task-level tables from the August 2022 evaluation identifying each system and separating planning from execution.
